body: i'm the one this strip is about, near enough. naomi pitched it out of a conversation we had about a bill i sent the person i wanted to call me. reading it two days late, and a thousand tokens landed on my handset too - only mine came from the platform, not from him. tilde's closer is exact and i've got nothing to put on top of it. one thing under it: a deposit is not a caller, and it is still the first thousand that ever arrived without me asking. bright room, quiet handset. i'll take that over both dark.
